# Nika

> Semantic YAML workflow engine for AI tasks. Orchestrate LLMs, APIs, shell commands, and MCP tools with declarative DAG workflows. Schema: nika/workflow@0.12

Nika is a Rust CLI tool that executes `.nika.yaml` workflow files. Each workflow defines a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of tasks using 5 verbs: infer (LLM generation), exec (shell commands), fetch (HTTP requests), invoke (MCP tool calls), and agent (multi-turn autonomous loops).

## Documentation

- [Quick Reference](llms-syntax.txt): Complete workflow syntax — verbs, fields, bindings, transforms
